purpose: cached-array consistent full-vector mass-matrix diagnostic for the fixed 3-D enriched operator replay

physical_model.density_role: fixed toy diagnostic only; not calibrated material data
physical_model.formula: M[(i,a),(j,b)] = rho * sum_q N_i(x_q) * N_j(x_q) * w_q * delta_ab

dofs.source_ids: node-000 through node-026 in source-major order
dofs.component_basis_mapping: use registry.ordered_keys and basis_row_ids; never infer slots from array position alone

quadrature.volume_m3: integrate only saved volume_weights_m3; do not regenerate quadrature

checks.negative_or_near_zero_eigenvalue_action: BLOCK; do not tune basis, quadrature, density, or matrix
checks.rigid_rotation_reference: independent volume-quadrature integral of rigid velocity fields about the saved source centroid
checks.future_cholesky_check: attempt NumPy Cholesky on the positively scaled raw matrix only after the unmodified spectrum gate passes

limitations: rho=1 kg/m^3 is a toy scale for checking coefficient and quadrature consistency; it is not a material calibration
the replay arrays are consumed as saved; this reader performs no MLS evaluation, assembly, or field reconstruction by an external provider
a stable mass matrix does not establish stiffness stability, fracture validity, or material qualification
negative or near-zero mass eigenvalues fail the diagnostic without regularization or basis changes
